title: First American Financial Corporation Increases Quarterly Cash Dividend to 61 Cents per Share
summary: First American Financial Corporation Increases Quarterly Cash Dividend to 61 Cents per Share
body_markdown:
---


September 16, 2026, Santa Ana, Calif.


[First American Financial Corporation](http://www.firstam.com/) **(NYSE: FAF)** , **** a premier provider of title, settlement and risk solutions for real estate transactions and the leader in the digital transformation of its industry, today announced that its board of directors has declared a quarterly cash dividend of 61 cents per common share, an 11 percent increase over the prior level of 55 cents per common share.


“This dividend increase reflects our confidence in First American’s business prospects and our continued commitment to returning capital to shareholders. Improving market conditions, particularly in the commercial market, reinforce our optimism about the opportunities ahead,” said Mark Seaton, chief executive officer of First American Financial Corporation.


The cash dividend is payable on October 5, 2026 to shareholders of record as of September 28, 2026. ****


### **About First American**


**First American Financial Corporation (NYSE: FAF)** is a premier provider of title, settlement and risk solutions for real estate transactions. With its combination of financial strength and stability built over more than 135 years, innovative proprietary technologies, and unmatched data assets, the company is leading the digital transformation of its industry. First American also provides data products to the title industry and other third parties; valuation products and services; mortgage subservicing; home warranty products; banking, trust and wealth management services; and other related products and services. With total revenue of $7.5 billion in 2025, the company offers its products and services directly and through its agents throughout the United States and abroad. In 2026, First American was named one of the 100 Best Companies to Work For by Great Place to Work® and Fortune Magazine for the eleventh consecutive year. More information about the company can be found at[www.firstam.com](http://www.firstam.com/) .
